scope: Relevant desktop gaming CPUs commonly found in gaming PCs

performanceScale.metric: Relative native CPU-limited gaming performance at 1080p
performanceScale.method: Current models use Tom's Hardware 2026 scores where available. Older models are normalized through overlapping legacy benchmark results or estimated from adjacent models.
performanceScale.important: Scores are intended for broad classification, not as exact FPS predictions. Memory, motherboard firmware, game engine and GPU limits can materially change results.
